plans.name: GLM Coding Plan (Z.ai)
plans.blurb: Z.ai's subscription for GLM models in coding agents.
plans.terms: Z.ai allows the plan in coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi, Cline and Hermes, not in your own apps or services, and not shared (docs.z.ai/devpack/faq).

plans.name: GLM Coding Plan (Zhipu, China)
plans.blurb: The same plan bought on bigmodel.cn.
plans.terms: Zhipu allows the plan in supported coding tools, not in your own apps or services, and not shared.

plans.name: Kimi Code
plans.blurb: The Kimi membership's coding plan (not the Moonshot platform's pay-as-you-go keys).
plans.terms: For your own use in coding agents (Kimi's docs set up Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and Hermes). Kimi forbids changing a client's User-Agent: dino passes each agent's own.

plans.name: Kimi Code (China)
plans.terms: For your own use in coding agents. Kimi forbids changing a client's User-Agent: dino passes each agent's own.

plans.name: MiniMax Token Plan
plans.blurb: MiniMax's subscription (formerly the Coding Plan). Its key starts sk-cp-; a pay-as-you-go key won't do.
plans.terms: For individual, interactive use in coding tools; MiniMax points production use to pay-as-you-go (platform.minimax.io/docs/token-plan/faq).

plans.name: MiniMax Token Plan (China)
plans.blurb: The Token Plan bought on minimaxi.com.
plans.terms: For individual, interactive use in coding tools.

plans.name: DeepSeek API
plans.blurb: Pay as you go, from your DeepSeek balance.
plans.terms: A pay-as-you-go API key: any tool may use it.

plans.name: Atlas Cloud Coding Plan
plans.blurb: Atlas Cloud's plan, with its own key (Plan Management → Get API Key).
plans.models_note: Atlas Cloud lists every model it serves; the plan covers some of them, and turns the others down.
plans.terms: Atlas Cloud allows Claude Code, Codex and other coding clients.

plans.name: Other (Anthropic- or OpenAI-compatible)
plans.blurb: Any endpoint that serves Anthropic Messages or the OpenAI API, by its base URL.
